channel.title: NBA GRID

item.title: Luka Doncic Injury Update: Is He Playing? Latest Status and Injury History
item.description: Is Luka Doncic injured? Latest status after his Nov. 11 ankle sprain and back tightness, games missed this season, and his full injury history with the Lakers and Mavs.

item.title: Dylan Harper Injury Update: Spurs Guard Ruled Out After Slipping vs. Pistons
item.description: Dylan Harper slipped late in the Spurs' loss to Detroit and is out Thursday vs. the Clippers with left hip soreness. Latest status, what happened and the timeline.

item.title: Stephen Curry Update Today: Warriors Reveal Oblique Tear, Re-Evaluation Timeline
item.description: Stephen Curry has an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks. Here is the latest Warriors injury update and what it means for Golden State.

item.title: Cavaliers vs Knicks: Next Game, Results, Player Stats & How to Watch
item.description: Cavaliers vs Knicks: Cleveland won 115-107 at MSG on Nov. 11. Next game Nov. 25 (NBA Cup). Player stats, how to watch, series results and history.

item.title: Spurs vs Knicks: Christmas Day Finals Rematch Preview, How to Watch & Results
item.description: Spurs vs Knicks is back on Christmas Day at Madison Square Garden (12 p.m. ET, ABC/ESPN). Finals rematch preview, how to watch and every recent result.

item.title: How Much Does Luka Doncic Weigh in 2026?
item.description: Luka Doncic is listed at 230 pounds, but the Lakers had him at 242 in camp. His weight every year since 2018, his heaviest, and how he slimmed down.

item.description: Anthony Edwards had right-knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months. The latest Timberwolves injury update, return timeline and what it means.

item.description: The 2026 NBA preseason ran Oct. 3-16. See final preseason standings for all 30 teams, key dates, global games, whether preseason counts and how to watch.

item.title: Bulls Land Buddy Hield From Hornets, Move On From Rob Dillingham

item.description: Stephen Curry agreed to a 2-year, $116 million extension with Golden State, taking a discount off his max to stay through the 2028-29 season.

item.title: DOJ Opens Criminal Investigation Into Clippers Over Kawhi Leonard Deal
item.description: Federal prosecutors in Brooklyn opened a preliminary criminal probe into the Clippers over sponsorship deals allegedly used to pay Kawhi Leonard above the cap.

item.title: Mark Williams Undergoes Shoulder Surgery, Suns Left Scrambling at Center
item.description: Suns center Mark Williams had surgery on a torn labrum in his left shoulder and could miss up to five months, leaving Phoenix to lean on Ighodaro and Maluach.
